description: VN 'chụp ảnh' transfer: learners say 'make a photo/selfie' for 'take a photo/selfie'. Rule en-vietlish-collocation-take-photo rewrites the verb make->take (preserving tense and capitalization) ONLY when a photo/selfie token is the bare direct-object head noun. It abstains on photo compounds (photo album/book/booth) and never touches 'picture' or 'photograph'.
fp_risk_note: Medium risk. 'make' is correct for most created objects; 'photo' heads valid compounds (photo album/book/booth/frame), and 'make a picture' (draw/film) and 'make a photocopy'/'photograph' are legitimate. Negatives lock the compound surfaces, the already-correct 'take a photo', a non-photo object, and the photocopy token boundary.

positive.notes: Bare make + a photo head noun -> take a photo.
Past tense made -> took, trailing time adverb preserved.
Plural photos with no determiner -> take photos.
Progressive making + selfie head -> taking a selfie.

negative.notes: 'photo album' is a valid compound; photo is a modifier, not the object head -> must abstain.

negative.input: We make a photo book for grandma.
negative.expectedCorrection: We make a photo book for grandma.

negative.notes: Non-photo object: make is correct, must not fire.
'photocopy' is one token; the photo\b boundary must not match inside it.
Causative 'make X look Y' — photo is the causee, not the bare object head; a base verb follows, so the safe-tail boundary must reject it. (A4 regression lock.)

negative.input: I want to make a photo essay.
negative.expectedCorrection: I want to make a photo essay.
negative.notes: Unlisted photo compound ('photo essay'): a noun follows photo, so the safe-tail boundary must reject it without relying on a compound blocklist. (A4 regression lock.)
